$comment: Coverage is measured on the compiled JavaScript, since the suite runs through ts-node.
Thresholds apply to the whole report. The per-package breakdown that separates
real logic from re-export barrels is produced by `pnpm coverage:summary`; the
barrel files drag the raw totals down for no useful signal, so the gate is set
just below where the logic-only figure sits.
`check-coverage` fails the run when a threshold is missed, so a regression has
to be acknowledged rather than absorbed.
